shortDescription: Fills the firm's NSW will, enduring POA and enduring guardianship precedents from a confirmed instruction record. A solicitor confirms every step.
longDescription: Ingests a completed client instruction sheet, extracts a canonical instruction record in which every field carries its provenance in the sheet or is marked cannot be determined, and halts at a solicitor confirmation gate before any document work begins. Once the record is confirmed, the workflow fills the firm's own precedents — a will, an enduring power of attorney and an appointment of enduring guardian for New South Wales — at explicit {{field_name}} markers only, never rewriting precedent wording, adopting connected drafting-playbook positions where they cover a clause point and sending every uncovered clause choice to the gap report. Every fill returns a change manifest reconciling the output against the precedent, a gap report, and dated execution-formalities references verified against the official NSW legislation publisher. No precedent means no draft: the workflow fails closed rather than composing documents itself.
defaultPrompt: Extract an instruction record from this completed estate planning instruction sheet.
Present the extraction table with provenance for my confirmation before drafting anything.
Fill the firm's NSW will precedent from the confirmed instruction record.
Fill the enduring power of attorney and appointment of enduring guardian precedents for the same client.
Show me the change manifest and gap report for the last fill.
List the execution requirements for each document and where each one comes from.
whatItDoes: Extracts a provenance-cited instruction record from a completed instruction sheet and halts at a solicitor confirmation gate before any drafting
Fills the firm's registered NSW precedents at explicit {{field_name}} markers only, keeping names and roles consistent across the document set
Returns a change manifest, a gap report and dated NSW execution-formalities references verified against the official publisher with every fill
boundaries: Every output is a draft until the responsible solicitor reviews it — each document carries a DRAFT — SOLICITOR REVIEW REQUIRED banner
No precedent, no draft: the workflow never composes a will or instrument from scratch and never rewrites precedent wording outside markers
Never assesses testamentary capacity, undue influence, family provision or notional estate exposure, or tax — these are flagged to the solicitor, never resolved

Practitioner-only and NSW-only in this release: self-represented parties and other jurisdictions are routed OUTSIDE SCOPE; advance care directives and superannuation death benefit nominations are flagged, never drafted
